plan.summary: Fix prod 502 on GET /api/v1/settings/wa-templates: the live cxapi /api/templates `preview` field is a structured OBJECT (header/body/footer/buttons), not a string, so deserializing into WapCrmTemplateDto.Preview (string?) threw JsonException -> TransportError -> 502. Model preview faithfully + add the real top-level fields (name/language/category/paramFormat); update the SPA contract + Projeler template picker; add a parse regression test pinned to the verified live wire shape.
plan.q_intent: Q pasted a prod console log showing ai.invekto.com/api/v1/settings/wa-templates?instanceId=6570 -> 502. Diagnose and fix. Q chose: full structured model for preview + deploy immediately after Codex PASS.
plan.interview_notes: Root cause confirmed by reproducing the cxapi call from the whitelisted prod server (tenant 5050 / instance 6570): HTTP 200 with valid JSON but `preview` is an object -> JsonException -> env=null -> TransportError -> endpoint 502. Envelope (status bool / statusCode string) parses fine; extra fields name/language/category/paramFormat were silently ignored. First-ever live cxapi template parse in prod (send client gated/inert, instances cached) so the integration-guide-driven `preview: string` assumption was latent until now. Q decision: full structured model + immediate Backend+SPA deploy.

verification_questions.question: Does WapCrmTemplateDto now deserialize the verified live cxapi /api/templates wire shape (preview as an object {header,body,footer,buttons}) without throwing JsonException, so an object preview no longer collapses to TransportError -> 502?

The Shared DTO type of preview changed from string? to WapCrmTemplatePreviewDto? — is this safe across all consumers (no other microservice reads .Preview; only the deserialize site + SPA consume it, and both the SPA render and dropdown label were updated)?

Does the SPA picker avoid runtime errors under the new contract — specifically that the dropdown no longer calls preview.slice() (which would throw on an object) and the preview box null-guards header/body/footer/buttons?

Are null/empty sub-fields tolerated end-to-end (header:null, header.text:null for media, buttons:[], footer:null) so media-header / no-header / no-button templates neither break deserialization nor crash the render?

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: No new catch/swallow. The change makes a previously-failing deserialize succeed. Unknown cxapi fields are still ignored by System.Text.Json (default), which is intentional and non-silent (the picker only consumes known fields). SPA renders are null-guarded so missing sub-fields render nothing rather than throwing.

aha_moments.user_pain: The template picker silently 502'd with a generic 'şu anda alınamıyor' message, masking that the real response was a 200 with an unmodeled shape.
aha_moments.suggestion: Pin a parse regression test to the verified live wire shape so a future cxapi field/shape drift fails a test, not prod.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator opens Projeler -> templates load instead of an opaque error, and any future provider drift is caught in CI.

aha_moments.user_pain: The old dropdown showed a raw numeric templateId (e.g. 1664033448202974) — meaningless to the operator.
aha_moments.suggestion: Label options by human name + language, e.g. 'siparis_bilgi (tr)'.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator recognizes the template by its name and language at a glance instead of decoding an id.

aha_moments.user_pain: The preview was a flat string; operators couldn't see header/footer/buttons before sending.
aha_moments.suggestion: Render the structured preview (header text, body, footer, button chips).
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator sees a faithful render of the approved template — including buttons — before committing to a send.

aha_moments.user_pain: Support couldn't tell whether 502 was an outage or a content issue.
aha_moments.suggestion: The DTO doc + test now record the exact wire shape and the 2026-06-09 incident so support/devs have a single source of truth.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Next time a template error appears, the cause is documented in code, not rediscovered.

aha_moments.user_pain: Each language is a separate cxapi template slug, but the UI gave no language signal, so operators could pick the wrong-language template.
aha_moments.suggestion: Surface language in the option label so the right-language slug is one glance away.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator picks the correct-language approved template the first time, no trial-and-error.
